hypotheses.claim: Stocks ranked highest on causal medium-term relative strength outperform the same-session eligible universe over the next five sessions after costs.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic same-session relative-strength rank under the frozen swing policy.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Point-in-time swing universe rows with complete market, sector, liquidity, and five-session path evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Selected cost-adjusted and benchmark-relative economics fail either frozen temporal or unseen-ticker gates.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Five-session net return and excess return versus SPY and sector over the identical interval.

hypotheses.claim: Stocks in an established causal trend have positive five-session continuation after costs.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic trend-following rule using the same setup population.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Swing rows passing point-in-time trend, liquidity, warm-up, and feed-readiness gates.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Continuation economics fail either frozen validation scope or do not exceed the deterministic comparator.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Five-session net and benchmark-relative continuation return.

hypotheses.claim: A new, directly or causally related catalyst with technical confirmation produces delayed positive repricing over five sessions.
hypotheses.comparator: Technical-only and catalyst-only models on identical decisions.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Swing rows with reconciled direct, business, or sector catalyst relation available by the decision cutoff.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Technical-plus-catalyst fails to improve calibrated selection economics in temporal and unseen-ticker scopes.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Five-session net return and SPY, QQQ, and sector excess return.

hypotheses.claim: A positive point-in-time earnings surprise or guidance change produces delayed positive repricing over five sessions.
hypotheses.comparator: Catalyst Drift excluding earnings-specific surprise features.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Earnings announcements with verified surprise, guidance, publication, and decision availability evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: PEAD selection does not improve cost-adjusted benchmark-relative economics in both validation scopes.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Post-announcement five-session net and benchmark-relative return.

hypotheses.claim: A liquidity-adjusted three-session overreaction unsupported by catalyst and peer evidence partially reverses.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic standardized-return reversal rule.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Swing rows with an extreme stock-specific move, adequate liquidity, exact paths, and complete catalyst coverage.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Reversal returns fail cost-adjusted temporal or unseen-ticker gates or are explained by continuing catalysts.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Three-session reversal net return and sector-residual return.

hypotheses.claim: Price compression followed by a confirmed price and consolidated-volume breakout continues over five sessions.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic breakout rule on the identical setup population.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Swing rows with causal compression, breakout, SIP volume, liquidity, and exact five-session path evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Continuation and failed-breakout economics do not pass both validation scopes after costs.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Five-session net return, MFE, MAE, and benchmark-relative return.

hypotheses.claim: Stock-specific strength remaining after causal market and sector removal persists for five sessions.
hypotheses.comparator: Cross-Sectional Momentum without sector residualization.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Swing rows with point-in-time sector identity and identical stock, market, and sector intervals.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Residual momentum fails cost-adjusted temporal or unseen-ticker economics or adds no value over raw momentum.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Five-session net sector-residual and SPY-relative return.

hypotheses.claim: A statistically stable point-in-time peer spread converges after an abnormal divergence.
hypotheses.comparator: No-trade and single-name short-term reversal comparators.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Pairs with point-in-time peer membership, stable predecision spread tests, and executable two-leg cost evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Spread convergence fails walk-forward stability, cost, capacity, or structural-break gates.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Five-session market-neutral pair return after two-leg costs.

hypotheses.claim: A causal opening-range breakout with price, relative-strength, and volume confirmation reaches its target before its stop within 60 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic opening-range breakout rule.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Opening-session rows with completed opening range, SIP volume, exact one-minute path, and spread/cost evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Target-before-stop probability and selected net economics fail temporal or unseen-ticker gates.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Target-before-stop, stop-before-target, timeout, and 60-minute net return.

hypotheses.claim: A catalyst-confirmed overnight gap with premarket and opening-volume support continues over the next 60 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic gap-continuation rule without learned ranking.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Opening-session gaps with complete overnight, catalyst, SIP volume, and exact one-minute path evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Continuation economics fail both validation scopes after spread, impact, and adverse-fill stress.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 60-minute target/stop/timeout outcome and net benchmark-relative return.

hypotheses.claim: An unsupported or exhausted opening gap mean-reverts over the next 60 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic gap-fade rule and Gap Continuation eligibility veto.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Opening gaps lacking continuation confirmation with complete catalyst, liquidity, and exact path evidence.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Fade economics fail both validation scopes or overlap materially with continuation eligibility.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 60-minute reversion path, net return, MFE, and MAE.

hypotheses.claim: A supported VWAP reclaim or hold continues over the next 60 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic VWAP continuation rule.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Session-stratified rows with causal VWAP, relative strength, SIP volume, and exact one-minute paths.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Continuation economics fail either validation scope or are confined to one session segment.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 60-minute target/stop/timeout and net benchmark-relative return.

hypotheses.claim: An excessive liquidity-adjusted VWAP extension without continuation confirmation mean-reverts within 30 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic VWAP-extension fade rule.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Session-stratified rows with causal VWAP distance, spread/liquidity controls, and exact one-minute paths.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Reversion economics fail both validation scopes or disappear after spread and adverse-fill stress.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 30-minute reversion path, net return, MFE, and MAE.

hypotheses.claim: Same-cutoff intraday price and consolidated-volume leadership persists for 60 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic intraday momentum rank.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Session-stratified cross sections with complete SIP volume, market/sector context, and exact one-minute paths.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Top-ranked net and benchmark-relative economics fail temporal or unseen-ticker gates.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 60-minute target/stop/timeout and selected net return.

hypotheses.claim: A liquidity-adjusted intraday price shock unsupported by order-independent confirmation reverses within 30 minutes.
hypotheses.comparator: Deterministic standardized-shock reversal rule.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Session-stratified shocks with spread, liquidity, market context, and exact one-minute paths.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Reversal economics fail both validation scopes after cost and adverse-fill stress.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 30-minute reversal net return, MFE, MAE, and downside event.

hypotheses.claim: Causal bid/ask event imbalance predicts the next 15-minute executable price move.
hypotheses.comparator: Trade-only and bar-based short-horizon momentum baselines.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Rows with historical quotes, depth, cancellations, trades, latency, and execution simulation.
hypotheses.falsified_when: OFI adds no out-of-sample net edge after latency, spread, impact, and queue-position stress.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: 15-minute executable net return and adverse-selection probability.

hypotheses.claim: Causal realized volatility and ATR provide a calibrated 60-minute conditional-risk baseline.
hypotheses.comparator: Unconditional session-segment variance.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Intraday decisions with complete causal one-minute returns and time-of-day context.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Forecast loss and calibration do not improve over unconditional variance.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Next-60-minute realized variance and downstream risk-selection economics.

hypotheses.claim: Time-of-day-adjusted GARCH(1,1) improves 60-minute conditional-variance forecasts and risk selection over realized volatility and ATR.
hypotheses.comparator: RISK.REALIZED_VOLATILITY.60M.V1 and HAR-RV.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Intraday histories with deseasonalized returns, separate overnight gaps, convergence, and sufficient warm-up.
hypotheses.falsified_when: GARCH fails out-of-sample QLIKE/calibration improvement or adds no drawdown, stop, or abstention benefit.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Next-60-minute conditional variance and downstream risk ablation.

hypotheses.claim: Asymmetric EGARCH shock response improves 60-minute conditional-risk forecasts over symmetric GARCH(1,1).
hypotheses.comparator: RISK.GARCH.60M.V1.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Intraday histories where predeclared asymmetry tests pass and EGARCH converges.
hypotheses.falsified_when: EGARCH fails QLIKE/calibration improvement over GARCH or adds no downstream risk benefit.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Next-60-minute conditional variance and asymmetric downside-risk calibration.

hypotheses.claim: Daily GARCH improves one- and five-session conditional-variance forecasts and swing risk selection over realized volatility and ATR.
hypotheses.comparator: Rolling daily realized volatility and ATR.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Daily histories with causal adjusted returns, sufficient warm-up, and converged GARCH fits.
hypotheses.falsified_when: GARCH fails out-of-sample QLIKE/calibration improvement or adds no swing drawdown or abstention benefit.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Next-one- and five-session realized variance and swing risk ablation.

hypotheses.claim: Multi-scale HAR-RV improves 60-minute realized-volatility forecasts over single-window realized volatility and ATR.
hypotheses.comparator: RISK.REALIZED_VOLATILITY.60M.V1.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Intraday histories with complete causal short, medium, and long realized-volatility windows.
hypotheses.falsified_when: HAR-RV fails out-of-sample QLIKE/calibration improvement or adds no risk-selection benefit.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Next-60-minute realized variance and downstream risk ablation.

hypotheses.claim: Calibrated downside, median, and upside return quantiles improve selection or abstention over binary probability alone.
hypotheses.comparator: Passed binary specialist using the same rows and selection policy.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Rows from independently passed swing or intraday specialists with exact return paths.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Quantile coverage fails by regime/liquidity or quantiles add no cost-adjusted selection benefit.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Conditional return quantiles and interval coverage.

hypotheses.claim: Competing-risk modelling improves calibrated target, stop, timeout, and time-to-resolution estimates over independent binary models.
hypotheses.comparator: Passed specialist opportunity/downside models on identical paths.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Exact target, stop, timeout, and censored paths from independently passed specialists.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Event/timing calibration fails or competing risks add no selection or abstention benefit.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Target, stop, timeout probabilities and time to resolution.

hypotheses.claim: A causal meta-label can reject weak occurrences of a deterministic primary setup and improve net economics.
hypotheses.comparator: The independently passed deterministic primary setup without meta-labelling.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Occurrences of one frozen primary setup with complete causal features and exact outcomes.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Meta-labelling fails temporal or unseen-ticker incremental economics or increases instability.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Incremental selected net and benchmark-relative return with drawdown.

hypotheses.claim: A causal regime router improves outcomes by selecting among independently passed specialists.
hypotheses.comparator: Each passed specialist and a fixed non-routed policy.
hypotheses.eligible_population: Decision-time regime states and outputs from independently passed compatible specialists.
hypotheses.falsified_when: Routing fails temporal or unseen-ticker incremental economics or depends on future-defined regimes.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Incremental routed net and benchmark-relative return with calibration and drawdown.
